raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

An image above twice `Image.MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS` (178,956,970 pixels) makes `Image.open` raise `DecompressionBombError`, before any decode. That class subclasses `Exception`, not `OSError`, so neither `except (OSError, SyntaxError)` in `_load_image` nor `CLIENT_MEDIA_EXCEPTIONS` catches it. `_load_single_item` then reports the image the client sent as a server fault, a 500, where `test_base_processor_bad_input.py` says client media that cannot be decoded raises `ValueError`.

```
$ PYTHONPATH=python python bomb.py   # main 279f1fa, Pillow 12.3.0
PNG 27385 bytes, 225,000,000 pixels, Pillow limit 89478485
RuntimeError <- DecompressionBombError: 0...: Image size (225000000 pixels) exceeds limit of 178956970 pixels, could be decompression bomb DOS attack.
```

Refs #43707: once #43713 restores the Pillow limit for NanoNemotron, those requests reach this path too.

## Modifications

- `utils/common.py`: add `Image.DecompressionBombError` to `CLIENT_MEDIA_EXCEPTIONS`. Every user of the tuple (`llava.py`, the encoder preprocessor, `systemone/serving.py`) gets the same 400.
- `test_base_processor_bad_input.py`: a 15000 x 15000 1-bit PNG, about 27 KB, must raise `ValueError` caused by `DecompressionBombError`. The class also joins `test_tuple_covers_the_documented_families`.

## Accuracy Tests

Not applicable: no model output changes.

```
$ PYTHONPATH=python python -m pytest -q test/registered/unit/multimodal/test_base_processor_bad_input.py
11 passed, 2 warnings, 16 subtests passed in 10.87s
# not run: a live server; ValueError to 400 rests on serving_chat.py:2301
```

Baseline on `279f1fa` is `10 passed, 2 warnings, 15 subtests passed`. With the `common.py` change reverted and the tests kept, it is `2 failed, 10 passed`: `test_decompression_bomb_image` and the `DecompressionBombError` subtest. `ruff` 0.15.1 (`--select=F401,F821`, `format --check`), `isort` 7.0.0 and `codespell` 2.4.1 pass on both files.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not applicable: one more class in an `except` tuple.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
  - No user-facing option or documented behavior changes.
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
  - Error classification only; no forward or kernel code is touched.
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

@mickqian this keeps Pillow's guard and only moves its failure from 500 to 400. I'd leave a pixel cap out: vLLM's `VLLM_MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS` defaults to the same 178,956,970, so copying it adds a knob, not a tighter limit. Do you want one anyway?

files.patch:
@@ -1853,9 +1853,12 @@ def get_mm_http_session() -> requests.Session:
 
 # Raised by the loaders below when client-supplied media cannot be fetched or
 # decoded. ValueError is in the set because invalid base64 raises binascii.Error.
+# Pillow raises DecompressionBombError from Image.open, before any decode, for an
+# image above twice Image.MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS; it subclasses Exception, not OSError.
 CLIENT_MEDIA_EXCEPTIONS = (
     ValueError,
     UnidentifiedImageError,
+    Image.DecompressionBombError,
     requests.exceptions.RequestException,
 )

@@ -77,6 +77,15 @@ def test_lazy_pil_decode_failure(self):
                     _StubProcessor._load_single_item(media, Modality.IMAGE)
                 self.assertIsInstance(ctx.exception.__cause__.__cause__, OSError)
 
+    def test_decompression_bomb_image(self):
+        # 15000 x 15000 is above twice Image.MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS, so Pillow refuses it
+        # in Image.open, before decoding; a 1-bit PNG of that size is about 27 KB.
+        buf = io.BytesIO()
+        Image.new("1", (15000, 15000)).save(buf, format="PNG")
+        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "decompression bomb") as ctx:
+            _StubProcessor._load_single_item(buf.getvalue(), Modality.IMAGE)
+        self.assertIsInstance(ctx.exception.__cause__, Image.DecompressionBombError)
+
     def test_undecodable_audio_bytes(self):
         # soundfile raises LibsndfileError, a RuntimeError -- not a ValueError.
         self._assert_client_error(b"definitely not audio", Modality.AUDIO)
@@ -122,6 +131,7 @@ def test_tuple_covers_the_documented_families(self):
             requests.exceptions.ConnectionError,
             requests.exceptions.Timeout,
             binascii.Error,  # invalid base64
+            Image.DecompressionBombError,
         ):
             with self.subTest(exc_type=exc_type.__name__):
                 self.assertTrue(issubclass(exc_type, CLIENT_MEDIA_EXCEPTIONS))
